name: overlap-pairs-v1
status: Labels reviewed by Samarth 2026-10-25 (n2 changed to duplicate; d7 note to confirm)
about: Each pair: a proposed_question (as the pipeline would propose it) and a published_review from PubMed. label 'duplicate' = the published review already answers the proposed question. 'different' = same topic, but one element changes the question (hard negatives). The evaluation fetches the review's title and abstract from PubMed by PMID; title_for_reference is only for a person reading this file.

pairs.label: duplicate
pairs.note: Same question as the earlier review (PMID 28658157) the candidate is modelled on.

proposed_question.title: Tranexamic acid plus drain clamping to reduce blood loss after primary total knee arthroplasty
proposed_question.population: adults undergoing primary total knee arthroplasty
proposed_question.intervention: tranexamic acid combined with temporary drain clamping

definition: duplicate = the proposed review would repeat work already in the published review, whether its scope is the same, narrower, or wider and containing it. The only exception is an explicit update of the original review (enough new eligible studies since its search). rejected_for_other_reasons records rejections that are not about this pair (other gates), and is not used when scoring the overlap judge.
